restricted.title: Variable pay is restricted
restricted.description: One-off earnings and deductions are visible to HR roles only. Ask an administrator to grant you HR Manager or HR Admin access in this institute.

errors.deleteFailed: Could not remove this adjustment. If a payroll run has already picked it up, reject that run first.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load adjustments for this month.

intro: One-off earnings and deductions for a single month — an incentive, an arrear, a recovery. Each one waits here until a payroll run for its month and scope picks it up; once a run has, it is locked and can only be undone by rejecting that run.

emptyState.title: Nothing extra this month
emptyState.description: No adjustments recorded for the selected month. Anything you add here will be picked up by the next matching payroll run.

removeDialog.title: Remove this adjustment?
removeDialog.description: {{label}} will no longer be applied to the next payroll run for {{month}}/{{year}}. This cannot be undone — you would have to add it again.
